cards.front: What is the primary function of the mitochondrion?
cards.back: To produce ATP through cellular respiration - the main energy currency of the cell.

cards.front: Which organelle is responsible for protein synthesis?
cards.back: The ribosome. Free ribosomes make cytosolic proteins; ribosomes on the rough endoplasmic reticulum make proteins destined for membranes or secretion.

cards.front: What is the difference between prokaryotic and eukaryotic cells?
cards.back: Prokaryotic cells have no membrane-bound nucleus or organelles; eukaryotic cells have a true nucleus and membrane-bound organelles.

cards.front: What is the role of the Golgi apparatus?
cards.back: It modifies, sorts and packages proteins and lipids received from the endoplasmic reticulum for transport to their final destinations.
